upstream.algorithm: Upstream geometric position and attitude controller

files.license_notice: No file-level license header; repository GPL-3.0 license retained

upstream.licenses: MIT notice in controller_lee.c; GPL-3.0 notices in associated firmware headers; original notices and LICENSE.txt retained.
upstream.modifications: Official file bytes are unchanged. The local wrapper configures the scheduler frequency, supplies physical mass/inertia, and marshals inputs/outputs.
upstream.bundle_license_note: This native bundle is not labeled MIT-only: GPL-3.0 firmware headers and the full upstream GPL license accompany the MIT-noticed controller and math header.

controller_configuration.roles: Study payload/tension allocation, formation and recovery references; upstream C position/attitude feedback; shared bounded motor mixing

role_separation: Shared study payload/tension allocation and recovery/formation references; pinned unchanged upstream Lee C position/attitude feedback; shared bounded rotor mixer
clock_adaptation: The wrapper configures the source scheduler for the 50Hz study control period; upstream default is500Hz. Published feedback gains remain unchanged.
calibration: Mass and diagonal inertia are supplied from the official Menagerie Crazyflie2 body model
allowed_planners: rule_fixed and rule_reconfigure only; no learned or exact-option predictions with an external controller
score: Original three-waypoint/two-operation delivery and registered excursion/donor-tension limits
